multi_entity_note: Index patient, three other LCNEC cases, and several hospitals in different roles.

medical.diagnosis.value: paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with LCNEC of the lung
medical.diagnosis.rationale: He was finally 'diagnosed with paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with LCNEC of the lung', superseding the earlier immune-mediated/autoimmune encephalitis diagnosis.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: IVIG is the drug administered after the final diagnosis was made (corticosteroids are named only as a class); methylprednisolone preceded it, other drugs treated fever/pneumonia.
